title.narrative: Development of the National Green Growth Index and pipeline of projects

description.narrative: The objective of this PIN is two folds. Firstly, the Green Growth Performance Measurement and Potential Assessment (GGPM/PA) will identify the country’s green growth priorities and guide GGGI and the Government of Ghana by measuring the country’s performance in achieving sustainability targets, including Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), Paris Climate Agreement, and Aichi Biodiversity Targets for four green growth dimensions: efficient and sustainable resource use (ESRU), natural capital protection (NCP), green economic opportunities (GEO) and social inclusion (SI). This will provide an evidence-based support in the development of the GGGI Ghana Country Programme Framework (CPF). Secondly, to support the Government of Ghana to unlock access to climate finance through developing pipelines of projects.

title.narrative: Ghana National Green Growth Index established and initiated, and a pipeline of Climate Finance proposals available.
